scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a competent job investigating the binlog and identifying the general pattern (signing files in a shared output directory causes access-denied errors). However, it missed the likely root cause specific to CloudBuild environments - CAS hard links that make files read-only. Instead it attributed the issue to a generic parallel build race condition. The investigation was efficient (13 tool calls, no errors), and the recommendations are partially useful, but the core diagnosis is somewhat off-target for the likely actual cause in this build environment.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects
